verdict.rationale: Vapi docs confirm you can plug in a custom/cloned voice ID from a supported provider into an assistant config (vapi-docs-9, vapi-docs-26, vapi-docs-8, vapi-docs-35), but there is no mention anywhere of a consent process, verification, or compliance workflow for voice cloning itself — Vapi treats voice cloning as the provider's responsibility, not something it documents or enforces. Missing for 10: any documented consent/verification process for cloning a voice, first-party guidance on obtaining rights to a voice before cloning, and independent confirmation that this consent flow exists.
